title: Ordinary evaluation commutes with normalized native adjoint comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and an integer n≥0. Use the sequence module categories and ordinary inverse/direct adjunction of [def-sf-integral-system-operations, def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core], and the native module adjunction and evaluations of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations, def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. Define ordinaryEvaluation as inverse sequence evaluation followed by the intrinsic constant-module inverse-image comparison. Define nativeFinitePullIso by ordinary left-adjoint uniqueness for the finite right-adjoint coordinate isomorphism compactSupportDirectModel; its inverse is conjugate to that right-adjoint isomorphism. Let r compare the ordinary sequence direct image with native push and suppose that evaluating r then applying the ordinary native direct evaluation [lem-weil-compact-support-ordinary-direct-evaluation-sections] equals the normalized sequence direct evaluation. Then evaluating the corresponding whole-system left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism followed by native moduleEvalG equals ordinaryEvaluation followed by nativeFinitePullIso.inv. This equality is natural and holds for every ordinary sequence module.

source.place: Coefficient comparisons preserve evaluation and adjunction units/counits; primitive whole-system operation comparison in Step 1 of lem-sf-integral-support-strict-tower-comparison. Stacks 03DI, 0941, 0D6E; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10.

proof.text: Define ordinaryEvaluation as sequence inverse evaluation followed by the intrinsic finite-level comparison, and nativeFinitePullIso by left-adjoint uniqueness for compactSupportDirectModel. The counit formula for left-adjoint uniqueness proves that the conjugate of nativeFinitePullIso.inv is compactSupportDirectModel.hom.

Transpose ordinaryEvaluation.inv using its defining unit normalization and the intrinsic left-adjoint uniqueness normalization. The result is pullbackTensorSequenceDirectEvaluation.hom. The native unit normalization similarly identifies moduleEvalG.inv with moduleEvalP.hom under transposition.

For any ordinary right-adjoint isomorphism r whose finite evaluation square commutes, transport adjunction mates through the two left-adjoint uniqueness comparisons. The direct square hypothesis and mate injectivity give the asserted ordinary inverse-image evaluation square.

theorem ordinary_pull_square {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (r : pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f ≅
      ProEtale.VaryingRing.push (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f)
    (hr : ∀ N, (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).map (r.hom.app N) ≫
      (compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation l E f n).hom.app N =
        (pullbackTensorSequenceDirectEvaluation l E f n).hom.app N)
    (M : coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) :
    (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).map
      ((ordinaryPullIso l E f r).hom.app M) ≫
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.moduleEvalG (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f n).hom.app M =
    (ordinaryEvaluation l E f n).hom.app M ≫
      (nativeFinitePullIso l E f n).inv.app
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).obj M)
